gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Amatic SC looks like a marker dragged in one steady line, rustic and a bit quirky. Noto Sans Oriya, a sans-serif with generous curve gaps and small letters nearly as tall as its capitals, keeps a long page easy to follow.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-osage: Hand-lettered and gently monotone, Amatic SC draws every stroke at the same pressure, like a marker never lifted. And Noto Sans Osage fills the line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping open curves, so the handwriting finds a sturdy partner.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: A marker-like line of constant width gives Amatic SC its rustic, hand-drawn charm, with terminals stopping well away from the stem. Noto Sans Osmanya then runs on smoothly.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong stands tall, with a high x-height and rounds that gap open. Beside it, Amatic SC's unvarying, handwritten stroke feels quirky and rustic, and the two sit together like a sketched sign hung over a tidy, contemporary page.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC traces every glyph with a single marker thickness and leaves its terminals hanging away from the stems. Noto Sans Palmyrene is the plain sans that tames it.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau reads clean and modern, its open-ended curves given room to breathe. Under Amatic SC's rounded-rod, single-weight handwriting, a longer page would drift along easily, with only a short step from lowercase to capital.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa is approachable, with see-through c openings and a gentle bump up to capitals. Amatic SC's constant-width, handwritten strokes sit above it like a casual marker note, quirky against the body's contemporary calm.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahla: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi has gaping mouths on its e and capitals that barely rise. But Amatic SC glides above it like bent wire, rustic and handwritten, so the two feel casual and capable at once.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Wire-bent s curves that never thin at the spine make Amatic SC unmistakably handwritten and quirky. Noto Sans Rejang answers with wide, porthole-like counters, and that open, readable clarity is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-runic: Amatic SC lays down a steady, pressure-free marker line, rustic and quirky, with terminals that stop far from the stem. Noto Sans Runic, a plain sans with a big x-height, would swallow it if the heading shrank.
